# Support

This page explains where to get help with zever.

## Documentation

Start with the [README](https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever#readme). If zever has package documentation, it is published on [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/zenta-dev/zever).

## Questions

For questions about how to use zever, prefer GitHub Discussions:

- **GitHub Discussions**: https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever/discussions
- **GitHub Issues**: https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever/issues (bug reports and feature requests only)

If you are unsure whether something is a bug or a usage question, start a discussion and a maintainer will help route it. Do not open an issue if you have not first tried the documented APIs.

## Bug reports and feature requests

- **Bug reports**: https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever/issues/new/choose and select the *Bug report* form.
- **Feature requests**: https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever/issues/new/choose and select the *Feature request* form.

Please search existing issues before opening a new one.

## Security vulnerabilities

**Do not use the public issue tracker to report security vulnerabilities.** Report them privately through GitHub Security Advisories:

- https://github.com/zenta-dev/zever/security/advisories/new

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for details.
